learningPath.title: 7-Day Learning Path
learningPath.subtitle: From beginner to advanced, one topic per day. Master OpenClaw step by step.

day1.title: Meet OpenClaw
day1.description: Install OpenClaw, connect your first platform (Telegram/Discord), and have your first conversation with your AI assistant.

day2.title: Deep Conversations
day2.description: Master conversation techniques: context management, multi-turn dialogue, persona customization, and memory settings.

day3.title: Files & Code
day3.description: Let your AI handle files: read documents, write code, run scripts, and manage your local file system.

day4.title: Web Capabilities
day4.description: Unlock web powers: search the internet, scrape pages, call APIs, and integrate with online services.

day5.title: Skill Extensions
day5.description: Install community skills from ClawHub to extend capabilities: GitHub, weather, smart home, and thousands more.

day6.title: Automation
day6.description: Set up scheduled tasks, heartbeat checks, proactive reminders, and automated workflows for your daily routine.

day7.title: Advanced Techniques
day7.description: Multi-agent orchestration, browser control, device integration, and building your own custom skills.

testimonial1.name: Alex Chen
testimonial1.quote: OpenClaw replaced 5 different tools in my workflow. I use it to manage servers, write code, and automate deployments. It's like having a junior dev who never sleeps.

testimonial2.name: Dr. Sarah Kim
testimonial2.quote: The architecture is elegant — gateway-based multi-platform support with a pluggable skill system. I've built 3 custom skills for my research pipeline already.

testimonial3.name: Marco Liu
testimonial3.quote: We deployed OpenClaw on Feishu for our team. It handles daily reports, monitors our services, and even reminds us of deadlines. The ROI is incredible.
